description: The latest successful browser demonstration avoided the unnecessary evaluation autograd graph.

notes: The peak occurs during evaluation (event index 609 aligns with first evaluate() call at step 1). Training batch is 1, so training peak is small.
Reserved - allocated ≈ 0.07 GB at peak; the fragmentation_indicator is high but not confirmed. The dominant cause is the avoidable evaluation activation working set.
Overlap: removing evaluation activations also removes their dependent temporaries (LayerNorm/GeLU buffers). The sum 2.257 GB is the combined peak contribution of both categories during evaluation.
Policy allows numerics_change=false and model_change=false; this fix is a pure autograd lifetime change.
No optimizer state or gradient buffers appear at peak (grads=0, optimizer_state=0), consistent with evaluation path.

root_causes.title: Evaluation runs full batch 16 with autograd enabled, creating large activation working set
Evaluation forward creates large temporary buffers for LayerNorm and GELU over full batch
Unclassified allocation from model initialization / weight copy

limitations: Independent browser demonstration; it is not part of a fixed-nine campaign and is not added to campaign repair scores.
No Tavily source links were recorded for this run.
